facility.name: Wanda Webb
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A 19-month-old child was watching a television show with the other children in care. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver was informed that children under two can't have screen time and the television was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The parent handbook was missing information on parents' rights, water activities, and the HHS website.

Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: There were cleaning supplies under the sink in the bathroom that the children use. This was corrected during the inspection when the supplies were moved out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Out of four children's files, one child needed updated immunizations.

Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver was missing training in emergency preparedness, food allergies, and understanding building and physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The primary caregiver's first aid and CPR training expired in August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The home's parent handbook did not have a section addressing parent's rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers: The emergency numbers for 911, Texas Abuse and Neglect hotline, and the home's number, name and address were not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.403)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: There was no written activity plan available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience: The primary caregiver did not have a certificate for training in food allergy reactions available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: There was an infant sleeping in a play yard with a blanket. This was corrected during the inspection when the blanket was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: There was no documentation for drills or testing of the fire extinguisher, carbon monoxide detector, and smoke detector available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions for an infant who was still on formula.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: There was an infant sleeping in a swaddle. This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was unswaddled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §747.2328)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy did not contain a policy on the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The provider did not have documentation of performing monthly fire drills.  This was corrected by the operation completing a fire drill during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: During the inspection it was found that the last documented certification was completed in September 2020. This was corrected by the provider reviewing the CPSC website during the inspection.
Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: During the inspection it was found that the CPR certificate was completed online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))
